body:
Layer 4 of the stack (layer 3: #308). The weekly pin bump becomes Python: `bump_pin`, `bump_run`, `bump_checks` and `bump_weekly` replace the shell scripts (archived), with the same pin-file edits, commit rows, PR titles and bodies, check-run marker (kept as `Reported by bump-checks.sh` so a rerun still recognizes check runs posted earlier) and exit codes (`bump_pin`: 0, 10, 1, 2, 3). `prune-daily.py` becomes `prune_daily.py` and now runs under the locked interpreter instead of the runner's `python3`.

The bump scripts start each other with the interpreter that runs them (`sys.executable -I`), not through a shebang, so the uv-managed Python is used all the way down. `bump-pins.yml` and `prune-daily.yml` call them with `uv run --frozen` and get the `setup-ci-python` step (the bump job also runs `just`, which is unchanged).

Verified locally: `tests/supply/bump-weekly.sh` (9 cases, same assertions, Python stubs for `bump_run` and `bump_checks`), `tests/pipeline/prune-daily.sh` (16 cases) and `inputs-hash.sh`; `bump_pin` and the chunkah path of `bump_run` also ran against fake skopeo and cosign in a scratch repository (pin rewritten, one commit with the table row, an unknown pin fails with the tree restored). Not verified: the brew and bins paths of `bump_run` (they call `just brew-bump` and `just bins-bump`, which need the real registry and keys), `bump_checks` (needs the real Test dispatch). Needs a real run: `gh workflow run bump-pins.yml --ref <branch> -f dry_run=true` exercises `bump_weekly` and `bump_run` end to end without pushing or opening anything; the prune runs daily with `DRY_RUN` on by default.

title: CI scripts in Python, 4 of 5: pin bump scripts and the daily prune
